name: danplaton4/tenancy-bundle
description: Multi-tenant Symfony bundle - zero boilerplate, zero leaks.

suggest.league/flysystem-bundle: Required for per-tenant Filesystem bootstrapper (Phase 24 / BOOT-03) (^3.7)
suggest.league/flysystem-memory: In-memory Flysystem adapter — used by the bundle integration tests AND the memory:// DSN scheme of AdapterDsnParser (^3.31)
suggest.phpstan/extension-installer: For zero-config auto-loading of the tenancy PHPStan rules
suggest.phpstan/phpstan-doctrine: For full Doctrine metadata support — enables XML/YAML-mapped entity analysis in Rule 3
suggest.symfony/messenger: Required for tenant context preservation across async message processing (^7.4||^8.0)
suggest.liip/monitor-bundle: Optional liip/monitor-bundle integration: when installed, HealthCheckIntegrationPass auto-registers a TenantConnectivityCheck as a liip_monitor.check service (HEALTH-07). Endpoints and CLI command work without it. (^2.25)
suggest.symfony/web-profiler-bundle: Adds a 'Tenancy' panel to the Symfony Profiler / WDT in dev — shows tenant slug, label, driver, resolver, bootstrappers, error state. Auto-registered only when kernel.debug=true; never loaded in prod. Most Symfony skeleton apps already have this in require-dev.
